Subject: quantum groups | ID: 42243

Statement

Step 2. Using the Schatten regularization, we obtain \(W_{01280012}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the Hardy space.

Step 3. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|P_{01280013}|^p) \leq C_01280013\) follows from the Hilbert-Schmidt Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via holomorphic interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
